client.name: Chanel S.A.S.
client.subtitle: Luxury Fashion & Beauty | Global Luxury Brand House
client.description: Chanel S.A.S. is a privately held French luxury house founded in 1910 by Gabrielle Coco Chanel in Paris. The company operates across fashion, fragrances, beauty, and fine jewellery, with over 600 boutiques worldwide. Chanel is owned by the Wertheimer family and is known for setting global standards in luxury craftsmanship and style.

serviceAreas.title: Fashion & Ready-to-Wear
serviceAreas.desc: Designs and sells seasonal clothing collections through boutiques and trunk shows worldwide.

serviceAreas.title: Fragrances & Beauty
serviceAreas.desc: Creates and markets perfumes, skincare, and makeup products sold globally in boutiques and counters.

serviceAreas.title: Watches & Fine Jewellery
serviceAreas.desc: Produces high-end timepieces and jewellery sold through dedicated boutiques and select retailers.

serviceAreas.title: Métiers d'Art Workshops
serviceAreas.desc: Owns and runs artisan workshops that supply hand-crafted components to Chanel and partner houses.

locations.label: Headquarters
locations.address: 135 avenue Charles de Gaulle, Neuilly-sur-Seine, France

priorities.title: Speed Up Seasonal Collection Planning
priorities.desc: Chanel runs two major fashion seasons plus cruise and pre-fall collections each year. Teams across design, production, and retail need to move quickly and stay aligned. Copilot can help staff draft briefs, summarise feedback, and track tasks without switching between tools.
priorities.pains: Slow briefing cycles, scattered feedback, manual task tracking

priorities.title: Improve Client Relationship Quality
priorities.tagline: Know your client, serve them well
priorities.desc: Chanel clients expect a personal and consistent experience across every boutique visit. Client advisors need fast access to purchase history, preferences, and upcoming events. Copilot can help staff prepare for appointments and follow up after visits more efficiently.
priorities.roles: Client Advisors, Boutique Managers, CRM Teams
priorities.pains: Time spent on manual prep, inconsistent client notes, slow follow-up

priorities.title: Streamline Global Reporting and Finance
priorities.desc: Finance and operations teams produce weekly sales reports, forecasts, and budget reviews across many markets. Much of this work is done manually in Excel. Copilot can help generate summaries, flag variances, and prepare board-ready slides more quickly.
priorities.pains: Manual data consolidation, slow report turnaround, formatting time

priorities.title: Strengthen Onboarding and People Development
priorities.tagline: Help people grow from day one
priorities.desc: Chanel hires staff across boutiques, offices, and workshops in many countries. Onboarding is often inconsistent and relies on printed materials or emails. Copilot and Viva Learning can help HR deliver structured, up-to-date onboarding content at scale.
priorities.pains: Inconsistent onboarding, hard to update materials, limited learning visibility

priorities.title: Reduce IT Support Load and Response Time
priorities.tagline: Fix issues faster, serve users better
priorities.desc: IT teams support thousands of employees across time zones, devices, and business systems. Many support requests are routine but still take time to resolve. Copilot can help IT staff write responses, summarise tickets, and document fixes more efficiently.
priorities.pains: High ticket volume, repetitive queries, slow documentation

capabilities.objectives: Help office staff draft and edit documents faster. Make it easier to find information stored across SharePoint and email. Reduce time spent on routine writing and admin tasks. Free up time for higher-value work.
capabilities.painPoints: Staff spend too much time writing emails and reports from scratch. Finding the right document in SharePoint takes too long. Meeting notes are often incomplete or never shared. Switching between tools breaks focus and slows work.
capabilities.keyActivities: Draft emails and internal memos using Copilot in Outlook, summarise long email threads before replying, search SharePoint for brand guidelines and product information, use Copilot in Word to edit and reformat documents, take and share meeting notes using Copilot in Teams

capabilities.objectives: Help managers run meetings more effectively and follow up on actions. Make it easier to track team progress across projects. Reduce time spent on status reporting. Give managers more time to coach and support their teams.
capabilities.painPoints: Managers spend too much time in meetings without clear outcomes. Action items from meetings are often missed or forgotten. Status updates require chasing team members manually. Preparing team performance summaries takes too long.
capabilities.keyActivities: Use Copilot in Teams to recap missed meetings and extract action items, create weekly team status updates using Copilot in Word, assign and track tasks using Planner with Copilot support, prepare talking points for one-on-one meetings using Copilot in Outlook, summarise project documents before stakeholder reviews

capabilities.objectives: Speed up the preparation of financial reports and forecasts. Help finance staff analyse sales data more quickly in Excel. Reduce manual effort in creating board and leadership presentations. Make it easier to spot issues in data before they escalate.
capabilities.painPoints: Weekly sales reports take too long to compile from multiple sources. Creating slides from Excel data is slow and error-prone. Finance queries require back-and-forth with regional teams. Budget documents need frequent reformatting for different audiences.
capabilities.keyActivities: Use Copilot in Excel to analyse sales data and flag variances, draft finance commentary and report summaries in Word, convert Excel analysis into PowerPoint slides using Copilot, send structured data queries to regional teams via Outlook, use Power BI with Copilot to build visual sales dashboards

capabilities.objectives: Make onboarding consistent and easy to update across all markets. Help HR staff create learning content faster. Use Viva Learning to deliver training to boutique and office staff. Reduce admin time so HR can focus on people, not paperwork.
capabilities.painPoints: Onboarding materials are stored in different places and go out of date quickly. Creating new training content takes too much time. HR staff spend too long answering the same employee questions. Learning progress is hard to track across markets.
capabilities.keyActivities: Build and update onboarding guides using Copilot in Word, publish and assign training modules through Viva Learning, draft HR policy documents and FAQs using Copilot, respond to common employee queries using Copilot-drafted email templates, track learning completion data in Power BI

capabilities.objectives: Help client advisors prepare for appointments faster. Make it easier to record and act on client preferences. Speed up follow-up communications after boutique visits. Give sales staff more time with clients and less time on admin.
capabilities.painPoints: Preparing for VIC appointments requires pulling data from multiple systems. Client notes after visits are often incomplete or inconsistent. Follow-up emails take too long to write personally for each client. New client advisors take time to learn brand communication standards.
capabilities.keyActivities: Use Copilot in Outlook to draft personalised follow-up emails after client visits, summarise client history from Salesforce CRM before appointments, record and store client preferences in structured notes using Teams, prepare appointment briefs using Copilot in Word, create event invitations for product launches using Copilot in Outlook

capabilities.objectives: Help IT staff resolve support tickets faster with less manual writing. Make it easier to document fixes and system changes. Use Copilot to draft user communications and training guides. Reduce time spent on routine helpdesk tasks.
capabilities.painPoints: Writing responses to routine support tickets takes too much time. System documentation is often out of date or missing. Communicating planned downtime to all staff is slow and inconsistent. IT staff spend time on simple queries that users could self-serve.
capabilities.keyActivities: Draft ticket responses and resolution notes using Copilot in Outlook, document system changes and fixes using Copilot in Word, create user guides and how-to articles using Copilot, use ServiceNow with Copilot summaries to triage and prioritise tickets, send scheduled maintenance notices using Copilot-drafted Teams messages

workflows.name: Seasonal Collection Launch

steps.d: Design lead writes the seasonal brief and shares it with the merchandising team.
Merchandising team reviews selected pieces and flags changes for production planning.
Operations team allocates stock to regions based on sales forecasts and boutique size.
HR and retail teams create product knowledge guides for all client advisors.
Retail managers brief boutique teams on the collection before the launch date.

workflows.friction: Creative briefs and product updates are shared by email and change frequently. Teams in different markets often work from outdated versions of documents.

workflows.name: Weekly Sales Reporting

steps.d: Finance analyst extracts weekly sales figures from SAP S/4HANA for all regions.
Analyst combines regional data into a single Excel file and checks for errors.
Finance manager writes commentary on key variances against budget and prior week.
Team converts the Excel summary into a PowerPoint deck for leadership review.
CFO office shares the final report with regional directors and senior leadership.

workflows.friction: Pulling and consolidating data from multiple regions takes most of the week. Writing commentary and building slides is manual and slows down the final review.

workflows.name: New Employee Onboarding

steps.d: HR sends welcome information and collects documents before the employee starts.
IT team creates accounts and grants access to required platforms on day one.
HR and brand team run a session on Chanel history, values, and standards.
Manager assigns role-specific learning modules through Viva Learning.
HR coordinator meets the new employee to review progress and address any issues.

workflows.friction: Onboarding materials are stored across email, SharePoint, and printed packs. New employees often miss key steps because no single system tracks their progress.

workflows.name: VIC Client Appointment Management

steps.d: Client advisor books the VIC appointment and logs it in Salesforce CRM.
Advisor reviews purchase history and preferences before the appointment.
Boutique team prepares selected pieces and a personalised welcome for the client.
Client advisor hosts the VIC and records preferences and purchases during the visit.
Advisor sends a personalised thank-you and product recommendation email after the visit.

workflows.friction: Advisors spend too much time pulling client information from different systems before each appointment. Writing personalised follow-up emails for every VIC is slow and inconsistent.

glossary.d: The full legal name of the Chanel company. S.A.S. stands for Société par Actions Simplifiée, a French company structure.
The private owners of Chanel. They have held ownership since the 1920s.
The suburb of Paris where Chanel's global headquarters is located. It is just outside the city centre.
Global CEO of Chanel since January 2022. She joined from Unilever where she served as Chief Human Resources Officer.
President of Chanel Fashion. He oversees the ready-to-wear and haute couture business.
Chief Financial Officer of Chanel. He manages the company's global financial operations.
Very Important Client. A term used for Chanel's highest-value and most loyal customers who receive special service.
A Chanel retail store. Chanel operates over 600 boutiques globally.
Chanel's core fashion division. It produces seasonal clothing collections shown at runway shows.
The division responsible for Chanel's perfumes, skincare, and makeup products. It includes iconic products like Chanel No. 5.
Chanel's division that designs and sells luxury timepieces and jewellery. It operates through dedicated boutiques.
A group of specialist artisan workshops owned by Chanel. They produce hand-crafted components for fashion houses including Chanel.
Custom-made luxury clothing produced to the highest craft standards. Chanel is one of the few houses certified to use this term.
A Chanel fashion collection shown between the main spring and autumn seasons. It is also called the resort collection.
Chanel's core enterprise system for finance, supply chain, and operations. It connects data across the global business.
The platform Chanel uses to manage client relationships and track sales activity. Client advisors use it to record appointments and preferences.
Chanel's HR and payroll system. It is used for hiring, performance reviews, and workforce management.
A suite of design tools used by Chanel's creative teams. It includes Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
The platform Chanel IT uses to manage support tickets and service requests. Staff log issues and track resolutions through it.
An AI tool built into Microsoft 365 apps. It helps users write, summarise, analyse, and find information faster.
A Microsoft tool for building data dashboards and visual reports. Finance and operations teams use it to track business performance.
Microsoft's document management and intranet platform. Chanel teams use it to store and share files.
A Microsoft tool that delivers training content inside Teams. HR uses it to assign and track learning for employees.
A Microsoft tool for internal communication and community building. It helps connect employees across locations.
The process of welcoming and training new employees when they join. At Chanel it covers brand values, systems, and role-specific training.
A set of training modules arranged in order for a specific role or skill. Viva Learning is used to assign and track learning paths.
The process of helping employees learn to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in their daily work. It includes training, practice, and change management.
Clothing that is made in standard sizes and sold in boutiques, as opposed to custom haute couture pieces. It is Chanel's main fashion product line.
A special event where a full collection is shown to selected clients, often before it reaches the boutique. It is a key sales and relationship tool.
A sales associate who works directly with clients in a Chanel boutique. They manage client relationships and provide personalised service.
The French word for house, used to refer to a luxury fashion brand. Chanel is often referred to as a maison.
A workshop or studio where garments or products are made by hand. Chanel's ateliers in Paris produce its haute couture pieces.
A French term meaning know-how or craft skill. Chanel uses it to describe the specialist skills of its artisans.
The region covering Asia and the Pacific, including key Chanel markets such as China, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, and Hong Kong.
A fashion collection released for a specific season, typically spring/summer or autumn/winter. Chanel releases multiple collections each year.
